name: TIP5P water
source: M. W. Mahoney, W. L. Jorgensen, J. Chem. Phys. 112, 8910 (2000), Table I (TIP5P column)
references: M. W. Mahoney, W. L. Jorgensen, J. Chem. Phys. 112, 8910 (2000)

atom_types.name: LP
atom_types.description: TIP5P lone pair (massless, 0.7 A from O, L-O-L 109.47 deg)

pairs.name: OW
pairs.comment: O-O Lennard-Jones: q_H 0.241 e (each lone pair -0.241 e), sigma 3.12 A, epsilon 0.16 kcal/mol, r_OH 0.9572 A, H-O-H 104.52 deg, r_OL 0.70 A, L-O-L 109.47 deg

bonds.name: OW-HW
bonds.comment: CHARMM's TIP3P constants (toppar_water_ions.str: HT-OT 450.0, HT-OT-HT 55.0) at the model's geometry; the model is rigid, they serve a flexible run only

angles.name: HW-OW-HW
angles.comment: CHARMM's TIP3P constants (toppar_water_ions.str: HT-OT 450.0, HT-OT-HT 55.0) at the model's geometry; the model is rigid, they serve a flexible run only

notes: built by CAPS (bench/ff/make_water_models.py) from M. W. Mahoney, W. L. Jorgensen, J. Chem. Phys. 112, 8910 (2000), Table I (TIP5P column)
rigid model: run it with its bonds and angle constrained (SHAKE / RATTLE in LAMMPS, SETTLE in GROMACS)
five sites: GROMACS writes the lone pairs as virtual_sites3 (3out); LAMMPS has no style for them
